entries.name: Retenue IRCM (revenus distribués)
entries.doc: LF 2025 art. 23, art. 82 (nouveau): "Les revenus des capitaux mobiliers entrant dans les provisions des articles 74 à 78 donnent lieu à l'application d'une retenue à la source au taux est de 18%."

entries.name: Retenue sur revenus des créances
entries.statute: CGI art. 118 (18 %, LF 2024 per the DGI circular)
entries.doc: DGI circular on LF 2024, para. 27: "Les dispositions nouvelles de l'article 118 du CGI visent à ramener le taux de retenue à la source applicable aux revenus des capitaux mobiliers ... revenus des créances, dépôts et cautionnements ainsi que les intérêts de bon de caisse, de 20% à 18%".

entries.name: Retenue sur les plus-values
entries.doc: LF 2025 art. 24: "Article 90 (ancien) Les plus-values sont soumises à une retenue de 20 % du montant net des plus-values. Lire: Article 90 (nouveau) Les plus-values sont soumises à une retenue de 18 %."
notes: CGI art. 90 (LF 2025): 18 % on the net gain; the scope of art. 90 (which gains) not re-read: applied to every disposal

entries.name: Stamp duty
entries.statute: Code général des impôts 2016 + LF 2023, 2024, 2025 (archived dgi.td copies; LF rewrite CGI articles)
entries.why: triage minor: droit de timbre in the francophone codes = fixed stamps per sheet / instrument (dimension, receipts, passports, vehicle papers): no household base in the model; transfers of immovables are carried by the P5 registration (mutation) duties where modelled. listed by the registry (confirmed in reachable text); charging provision not read/modelled in this pass

entries.name: Contribution des patentes (droit déterminé 0,1 % of turnover N-2, centimes CNPS/CCC/RAV, ONASA, TVLP 10 %)
entries.statute: CGI 2016 art. 790 I, III, IV; LF 2023 and LF 2025 (and the DGI circular on LF 2024) do not amend it; LF 2017-2022 not held
entries.doc: art. 790: droit déterminé 0,1 % of the turnover excluding tax of year N-2, the base capped at 2 bn with a tenth of the excess added (abatement of 9/10ths); centimes on the droit déterminé: CNPS 10 %, CCC 7 %, RAV 3 %; ONASA 480 F flat; TVLP 10 % of the annual professional rental value.
unsupported: communal increase of the tariff by council deliberation within the limit set annually (art. 790 II)
transporters' fixed and variable duties (art. 790 V-VIII)

entries.name: Zakat (as a tax)
entries.why: TD: the general tax code held (cgi2016.txt, 839k chars) has no zakat provision (full-text search 'zakat/zakât/zakah')

entries.name: Net wealth tax
entries.why: TD: the general tax code held (cgi2016.txt) has no charging provision on net wealth (full-text search 'impôt sur la fortune / le patrimoine', 'patrimoine net'); edition as held, later finance laws not all checked

entries.name: Taxe sur les véhicules de tourisme et breaks des sociétés (by fiscal horsepower)
entries.statute: CGI 2016 art. 199 (LF 2023, the DGI circular on LF 2024 and LF 2025 checked: art. 199 not amended)
entries.doc: art. 199 I: passenger cars and estate cars belonging to companies up to 7 CV 80 000 F, above 7 and up to 11 CV 120 000 F, above 11 CV 160 000 F; II: cars more than 5 years old at the balance-sheet date are reduced by 50 %, those over 10 years exempt. Households' cars are outside this tax (nil tariff here).
unsupported: 50 % reduction for cars over 5 years and exemption over 10 years (age not in the input: cars taken as at most 5 years old)
taxe pour la protection de l'environnement on vehicle owners (art. 200-202)

entries.name: Taxe forfaitaire due par les employeurs (7,5 %)
entries.statute: CGI 2016 art. 187-190 (LF 2023-2025 list the tax among payroll taxes without changing art. 190; edition flagged)
entries.doc: art. 187: salaries 'donnent lieu à la perception, au profit du budget de l'Etat, d'une taxe forfaitaire à la charge des personnes ou organismes ... qui paient les traitements'; art. 190: 'Le taux de la taxe est fixé à 7,5 % du montant brut des sommes imposables.'
unsupported: exempt employers (State, communes, international bodies, domestic staff not in business expenses, art. 188)

entries.name: Taxe d'apprentissage et de formation professionnelle (1,2 %)
entries.doc: art. 178: 'Le taux de la taxe d'apprentissage et de formation professionnelle est fixé à 12 pour mille', on gross pay (art. 173), payable by persons taxed under art. 16, 17, 49 and 130 (businesses).
unsupported: rounding of the base to the 1 000 F below (art. 177)

entries.name: CNPS employer contributions (pensions 5 %, work injury 4 %, family 7,5 %; up to 500 000 FCFA a month)
entries.statute: US SSA, Social Security Programs Throughout the World (SSPTW), Africa 2019, Chad (Wayback 2020-08-02, R4/fetch/p14/ssptw_chad.txt): employer 5 % (old age), 4 % (work injury), 7,5 % (family allowances, also cash maternity), maximum monthly earnings 500,000 CFA francs; official secondary, edition 2019 (flagged)
entries.doc: 5 + 4 + 7,5 = 16,5 % of wages up to 500 000 FCFA a month per employee. Fourteenth pass (FT reviewer 4: family not modelled).

entries.name: Contribution foncière des propriétés bâties, N'Djamena (10 % of rental value)
entries.statute: CGI 2016 art. 759-771 (communal tax; rates set by the CGI; LF 2017-2025 not checked for changes, flag)
entries.doc: art. 759: levied for the communes (for the State where no commune exists); art. 768: base = rental value at 1 January, 'ne peut être inférieure à 8 % de la valeur vénale'; art. 771: 'Les taux de la contribution foncière des propriétés bâties sont fixés à 10 % pour la ville de N'Djamena et 8 % pour les autres communes'; art. 762 7°: only houses of traditional materials are exempt (the household's home is taxed).
unsupported: rental-value floor of 8 % of market value (art. 768 IV)
rounding to the nearest 100 F, nil below 1 000 F
land (contribution foncière non bâtie 21 % / 20 %, art. 787) not modelled
